visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male with long brown hair, wearing a grey cardigan over a striped shirt and a purple undershirt, holds two 'Monster Hunter' 20th Anniversary wafer packs towards the camera. The background shows the interior of a modern train, likely a Shinkansen, with a beige headrest and window. (2) He rotates the packs to reveal the back, showing a detailed card list with numbered entries and small card previews at the bottom. His hands are prominent as he points to the text. (3) He uses his fingers to tear the top of one foil pack. A small wafer biscuit and a plastic-wrapped card are partially visible. (4) He pulls out a card featuring the 'Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak' cover art, showing a large red dragon. He tilts the card to show its reflective, high-quality finish. (5) He flips the card to reveal the back, which contains Japanese text, a '20th Anniversary' logo at the bottom right, and an illustration of a flying monster. (6) He tears open the second pack with a similar motion. (7) He extracts a second card featuring a dark, feline-like monster (Nargacuga) with glowing red eyes. The bottom of the card has a textured gold-foil effect. (8) He shows the back of the Nargacuga card, featuring a full-color illustration of the monster in a forest setting with descriptive text. (9) Two more cards are shown in succession: one featuring a silver dragon in front of a sun (Monster Hunter 2 cover) and another featuring a blue dragon (Azure Rathalos) with its name in gold text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker begins with a bright, welcoming greeting. The background is filled with the iconic 'Proof of a Hero' theme from Monster Hunter, featuring soaring trumpets and rhythmic orchestral percussion. (2) A sharp crinkling sound of a plastic foil bag being manipulated is heard as he discusses the product features. His voice is clear and slightly high-energy. (3) A loud tearing sound signifies the opening of the first pack. The music swells as he reacts with a sharp intake of breath and an excited 'Oh!' (4) As he reveals the first card, the sound of plastic film sliding is audible. He describes the card's quality with a satisfied tone. (5) Another distinct tear of plastic occurs as the second pack is opened. He makes a playful exclamation when seeing the Nargacuga card. (6) The video concludes with him summarizing his findings over the continuing heroic theme, ending with a final enthusiastic remark and the fading sound of card shuffling.
